chapters.title: it's not hard to see (the boy is mine)
chapters.html:
Phainon winced as he was hit by the smell of alcohol and sweat when he entered the club.

Ugh, he wished he was at home surrounded by his beloved game consoles and his boyfriend instead of being here but alas, his boyfriend was here and Phainon loved him more than his consoles.

He was aware that people gave him odd looks over his simple outfits –yellow hoodie, purple pants and simple white sandals– but he ignored them all to look around for a yellow mane belonging to his boyfriend.

He's probably at the bar with Hysilens since both of them didn't like to dance or mingle with other people.

Phainon liked Hysilens. Not only was she a lesbian with a happy relationship –no competition for him!– but she's also level-headed and able to stand up for herself. 

Both of them were pretty similar, actually. Had to be why they got along so well ever since Cerydra, Hysilens' girlfriend whom Mydei knew first from the high societal events his parents dragged him to, introduced her to him and Mydei.

Also, they were both gorgeous. 

Phainon might be Mydei-sexual, but even he could understand why Cerydra was head over heels for the singer. Or why the people seemed to be crowded over on one side of the bar.

He spotted Hysilens first, holding a paper cocktail umbrella for some reason on her right hand, wielding it like a weapon with the sharp end pointing toward… 

Phainon hastened his steps, probably bumping through people left and right but he didn't care when a man was talking with Mydei and Mydei was responding with a smile and the man bent down to–

He elbowed the guy on the side and watched with satisfaction as he recoiled and gave Phainon a gap where he could slot himself nicely next to Mydei where he belonged.

"Hey!" Phainon grinned.

Mydei only eyed the groaning, pathetic man before he sighed, "He only asked for the direction to the toilet."

"He's flirting." Hysilens commented, back on twirling the umbrella now that the perceived threat was taken care of.

See! This was why Phainon liked Hysilens. She was very self-aware, unlike his beloved gorgeous attractive amazing boyfriend who was unfortunately not blessed with it. 

"Whatever, he ran away after a slight nudge." Phainon saw him scurrying away toward the entrance like the coward he was before he focused on his number one, "Mydei! No kisses for your boyfriend who takes his time to pick you up?"

Mydei just ruffled his hair in response, but didn't protest when Phainon stole a kiss on the cheek. If they were at home he would totally go for Mydei's pretty kissable lips and have a long make out, but unfortunately he would have to be content with a cheek kiss and wait.

"Cerydra is here so I'm taking my leave." Hysilens announced after taking a look at her phone, "Thank you for today, little sea lion."

"We'll take you to the exit, Hysilens. Come, Phainon."

Phainon shamelessly linked his arms with Mydei's as they became makeshift bodyguards for Hysilens, who probably didn't even need one in the first place.

Cerydra was waiting in front of the exit, blocking it with a limousine while she was waiting inside with the window down. She was so over the top sometimes. Phainon loved her for it.

She was frowning, "I do not understand why you prefer this establishment every time."

She sounded disapproving, but she also never failed to pick her up every single time. Just like he was.

"It's just familiar." Hysilens said, "And the little sea lion liked the daiquiri."

Hysilens apparently got scouted here when she was just humming at the bar by herself. The scout took one look at her, asked her to sing a song –by which she sang Twinkle Twinkle Little Star– and the rest was history. The bar got popular thanks to her and in return, she got free drinks and reserved space and privacy whenever she came. 

"Hmph. Get in." Cerydra only curtly nodded toward the two before she had her window turned up.

Hysilens waved to them before she went to the other side where the chauffeur stood waiting to open the door for her.

Mydei spoke up first after their car had gone, "One of these days, maybe I want to be picked up like Hysilens does."

He gasped, "Do you want to? I can arrange one next week.. Or maybe tomorrow?"

"I'm just joking." He pinched Phainon's cheek. 

"Aww… I know you secretly liked grand gestures…" Mydei was so embarrassed when Phainon lit up fireworks with the words 'WILL YOU BE MINE?' but he and Phainon were still together until today so who's lying?

"Let's just go home." Mydei growled, embarrassed. He's so cute Phainon wanted to squeal.

"Oh, I just need to go to the toilet real quick! Can you wait by your bike?"

"Fine. I park over there. Don't take too long."

Phainon watched as Mydei walked toward the direction that he pointed before his expression darkened and he turned toward the corner.

And held the wrist of the man holding a flick knife easily, twisting it until he dropped the it and groaning in pain. He kicked the knife away until it was a safe distance from his attacker, although he doubted such a little thing could majorly injure him.

"Don't ever think that I won't realise that someone has been following us." His eyes narrowed, "Do you think Mydei will want you if you stab me? Is that it?"

He tightened his grip as the man babbled, "How the hell does he want to be with a loser like you?!"

Phainon straightened up, liked that he was towering over the man, liked that he could stare at him like he was an ant beneath his shoes, liked that he could feel the man wasn't as muscular as him and could be easily snapped in half. 

"I wonder why too sometimes." Phainon grinned, feral. "But that's not necessary for you to know. Because I won't let you get anywhere close to him. Or even at a staring distance because he was too radiant for the likes of you."

He stomped on the man's foot, satisfied with the sound of the crunch and the man instantly crumpling to the ground.

"I'll watch over you, Michalis Kastaros. Your mother and sister won't be safe from me."

The man paled, "How-"

When he smiled, it was cold, "Don't ask a question that you don't want the answer for."

Phainon left without anything to say anymore, although he could hear the man scream after several steps.

"Fuck! I'm sorry!" 

That was easy.

He donned his boyish smile, put his hands into the pockets of his pants and slouched again. And he was back to Phainon the e-gamer again.

"Mydeiii, sorry the toilet was crowded!" He faked panting after admiring how handsome his boyfriend looked while leaning against his motorcycle.

Mydei's eyes seemed to inspect him from head to toe while Phainon tilted his head in confusion.

"Hmph. It's good that you're unharmed."

Phainon let out a laugh, "What? I'm just going to the toilet."

"Okay." 

Mydei's motorcycle was truly a beauty that Phainon was always hesitant to ride even if Mydei had given him full permission even without him.

Not that it mattered because every time Mydei was out with Hysilens, Phainon had to ride him home.

Mydei scooted closer toward him, almost draping himself over Phainon. He's so cute. His boyfriend was never big on physical affection, but he's like a cat who secretly always wanted one especially when he's tipsy like this. Phainon believed that silence is golden in this particular case so he just faced the front so Mydei couldn't see him smiling.

"....smell of booze."

Ugh. Had to be from the man since he reeked.

"God, I'm sorry! The toilet is smelly!"

"I can defend myself, you know?"

Mydei sometimes said this cryptic thing like he knew what Phainon had done, but was content on letting him hide it. 

Phainon could never know how to respond to it so he finally said, thankful that he was holding his helmet to fiddle with the straps, "I know, but I'd like to protect you."

Mydei sighed but circled his arms around Phainon's abdomen, sighing with a tinge of fondness, "My knight in shining armour."

"Only for you, princess!"

"I'm not a princess." If Phainon could see Mydei right now, he would be 100% pouting.

Mydei would vehemently deny if he said so though, even though there's nothing wrong with it. Heck, he did it a lot to get what he wanted from his boyfriend and it never failed! 

"Okay, okay." Phainon started the engine.

"...But let me protect you too, even a knight should take a break sometimes."

If Phainon didn't have Mydei on his back, he certainly would have curled into a ball and cried.

"Oh, thank you!" Phainon could hear Mydei snorted so he cleared his throat and tried again, "I mean, okay, I will!"

"Just drive. I'm sleepy."

Mydei's helmet knocked into Phainon gently before he rested his head on his shoulder as Phainon rode toward their home.

End.
